about: The dock's Trash takes files dropped on it (docs/adr/0035-drag-and-drop.mdx, decision 12): sample/DragProbe.tsx (Allo) drags a file of the run's home through the platform's drag onto the Trash at the dock's end, Bloom's DropZone there taking files with a move alone, as a Mac's; the shell asks the session with the drop's serial (TrashFiles) and the file is in the home's Trash, gone from the home, the source learning the move; only the source and the shell's surfaces under the pointer (its desktop, then its dock) were told of the drag. Text dragged onto the Trash is no file: the Trash takes nothing, the drag ends with nothing dropped, the home as it was.

steps.name: a file dragged onto the Trash: it is in the home's Trash, the source learns the move
text dragged onto the Trash: it takes nothing, nothing is dropped
